5446661.reason: The formula computes the correct minimum but the unequal-frequency branch accumulates 0.5 and prints float tokens. On 0006 prints 8.0 instead of integer token 8; LF normalization does not change the numeric equality.

8675055.reason: Only pairs adjacent complementary mismatches although swaps may use any positions. On 0006 prints 11 instead of minimum 8; LF-normalized counterexample also remains wrong.

9220442.reason: Mishandles excess 4-to-7 mismatches and the residual swap budget, including unchanged positions. On 0004 (74747474 -> 77777777) prints 8 instead of four flips; LF-normalized input remains wrong.

9484371.reason: After a successful swap it continues scanning prior positions with a stale x, allowing further swaps to undo progress. On 0006 prints 10 instead of 8; LF-normalized input remains wrong.

9484480.reason: Repeated scans for an opposite mismatch are quadratic when no partner exists. On 0026 times out; this is not a counted algorithmically wrong numeric answer.
